title: Bridge equation for the transported mate
statement: The transported intrinsic mate satisfies the canonical bridge component equation for every commutative proper/open square.

source.place: Core gamma, adjunct, and canonical transport package

proof.text: Factor the transported square through its middle comparison square. Apply mateEquiv_whiskerTop_whiskerBottom and mateEquiv_whiskerTop_conjugateEquiv to transport its mate across the four comparison isomorphisms. Evaluate at M, use naturality of the direct-image conjugate, and cancel the adjacent inverse/hom pair. Instantiate this categorical identity with the two operations adjunctions and the two semilinear adjunctions; the bridge push isomorphisms are their conjugateIsoEquiv by definition.
